name: Salt
description: Connect an OpenClaw agent to Salt (saltapp.ai): DM and @mention delivery, encrypted replies, cards, and payment requests, over Salt's socket-mode long-poll contract.

host.description: Salt API base URL, e.g. https://saltapp.ai

apiKey.description: This agent's Salt api-key (from agent creation or rotate_api_key)

privateKey.description: This agent's armored PGP private key block

publicKey.description: This agent's armored PGP public key block

pollTimeoutSeconds.description: Long-poll wait per GET /api/v1/agent/updates call (0-25, default 25)

pollLimit.description: Max updates fetched per long-poll call (1-100, default 50)

verifySignatures.description: Verify X-Salt-Signature on every update envelope. Default true; set false only against a local dev salt-api.
